title: The Journalists’ Revolt Against AI Scraping
gist: Agustino Fontevecchia argues Big Tech's oligopoly has blocked a sustainable digital business model for news, and AI scraping is worsening the crisis. Spanish-language publisher Editorial Perfil is suing OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement.

insights.claim: Spanish-language publisher Editorial Perfil is suing OpenAI and Microsoft for copyright infringement over the use of its content by AI models.
insights.speaker: AGUSTINO FONTEVECCHIA
insights.so_what: Adds to the growing pile of copyright suits that could raise training-data costs or liabilities for AI model makers.

insights.claim: Fontevecchia argues that AI models such as ChatGPT and Claude are built on the wholesale theft of copyrighted work.
insights.speaker: AGUSTINO FONTEVECCHIA
insights.so_what: Framing that, if adopted by courts or regulators, could force licensing regimes and compress AI margins.

insights.claim: Fontevecchia contends Big Tech's oligopolistic dominance has prevented the news industry from building a sustainable digital business model, and AI is exacerbating that crisis.
insights.speaker: AGUSTINO FONTEVECCHIA
insights.so_what: Signals continued pressure on publisher economics and a push for platform/AI revenue-sharing regulation.
insights.quote: Big Tech’s oligopolistic dominance has prevented the news industry from developing a sustainable business model for the digital age—a crisis that AI is exacerbating.

insights.claim: Fontevecchia argues AI companies' narrative of immense benefits to humanity brushes aside the threat their models pose to journalism as a pillar of democracy.
insights.speaker: AGUSTINO FONTEVECCHIA
insights.so_what: Reputational and political backlash against AI firms may feed into regulation in media-sensitive jurisdictions.

insights.claim: AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude have become a mainstream technology within just a few years.
insights.speaker: AGUSTINO FONTEVECCHIA
insights.so_what: Rapid mainstream adoption raises the stakes of how content-licensing disputes are resolved.
